question: Five books labelled B, G, N, P and T are kept one above the other (not necessarily in the same order). Only one book is kept between N and G. B is just above P. B is above N. G is not above N. Which book is at the top?
solution:
Five Books are:- B,G,N,P,T

B is just above P.

B is above N.

G is not above N.

Only one book is kept between N and G.

 
 

 
 
B</p
